body:
Substance: Amanita Muscaria
Combination(s): 50/50 (by volume) Cannabis/Wild Dagga mix (2g plant material vapourized, repeated)
Dose: 5.2g @ T+0:00, 5.02g @ T+02:15
Route of Administration: Oral via tea extraction. (20-min steeping period)
Note: The following has been left largely as it was written during the experience; barring numerous spelling and punctuation corrections Ive made to make it easier to read.
>11:44 (T+0:00)
Tea is down. 5.2g Siberian A. Muscaria Grade 'B' batch. 3 vaped bowls of 50/50 cannabis/wild dagga down as well. Its taken me 20 minutes. Feeling very relaxed, with a few moments of nausea ten minutes ago, which could have been my empty stomach growling. Movement already impaired, I sway as if buzzed on alcohol and feel very mellow.
I sway as if buzzed on alcohol and feel very mellow.
Going to shower now.
>12:01 (T+0:17)
I felt like that shower was 25 minutes, I got lost in thought (probably the cannabis). My swaying and sedation have given way to swaying and not-giving-a-fuck-ness. I feel very strong and powerful, and I long for fresh air, nature, and physical exercise. I'm going to have another vape bowl, get dressed, then work out for as long as I feel like.
>12:26 (T+0:42)
Got sidetracked and decided to finish cleaning and sweeping out the garage. Although the cannabis was slowing my decision-making, I had no problem staying focused and on-task. I was exhibiting complex feats of strength with almost no effort (sweeping with a wide-head broom in the right hand, and scooping up dust with a full-size snow shovel in the left simultaneously). Hunger pains came so I wolfed down more water (the water has pretty well been constant).
>12:36 (T+0:52)
Working out feels great. I've been out of practice for five days now but I just picked up where I left off like nothing happened. Muscle contraction is easy and feels rewarding. Gotta try this as a pre-workout supplement. My heart is fast and strong, but not as fast as it might be if I were to have only had weed. I'm also not as fatigued as I would have been with just THC. Beginning to notice some micropsia as well as somnolence.
>13:07 (T+01:23)
Finished workout, feel very fatigued, want to sleep. My spatial sense is affected, room feel subtly smaller (or I am larger) which mimics 'beer goggles.' Just found out that the house may be mine for the rest of the day - time to go full shaman and dose another 5g. Getting hungrier.
>13:55 (T+02:10)
Apparently the other occupants will be home this afternoon around 17:00. I'm still going full shaman, even if I have to enclose myself in my room. 2 more vape bowls down 10 minutes ago and my second batch of tea is 50% drunk. I'm starting to feel very sleepy, might attempt the nap+wake technique, but what if the cannabis wears off while I'm sleeping? Better to stay awake. I'm going to grab more water.
>14:07 (T+02:23)
I'm going to go to sleep. I've finished 75% of my tea and I'm leaving the rest for when I wake up in 20 minutes. I'm going to get myself an extra bottle of water for backup. Bucket will be handy :-) Pupils shifting in size and eyelids very lazy. There is lots of breathing/movement in inanimate objects and my coordination is impaired. Touch sensations are numbed and all seem similar; I would describe them as having a 'soft' edge. My body feels warmed as if by some unseen embrace.
>15:06 (T+03:22)
After lying in bed for 40 minutes in a kind of dream-like state, I'm awake and moving, no longer tired. Going to reheat and finish my tea. I feel a little woozy, but nothing much. Still warm and fuzzy, beginning to feel the strain on my muscles from working out today. Some of the waking dreams I had felt very lucid and real, and actually prompted strong and real-feeling emotional responses from me when I would feel surprised or happy/sad. Often times I dreamt I had gotten out of bed to find an intruder in my home, waking up shortly after being startled.
>15:09 (T+03:25)
I've been noticing a reduced tolerance for itches this whole time, along with their increased occurrence. Also, slight muscular twitches have been present and notable this whole duration.
>15:28 (T+03:44)
3 more vape bowls and the last 25% of the tea finished. Poured more water and am now in shaman soul/body purge mode. No nausea to report, very clear headed, marijuana effects difficult to distinguish aside from the body high. Before vaping I was noticing enhancement of colour and complex textures as well as colourful blotches of patterns behind my eyelids, unlike the honeycombing of cannabis. I feel very slow and delayed, intense swaying, and strong dilation of time.
16:51 (T+04:07)
In after mowing the lawn. Coordination returning; I only made two big mistakes on the lawn tractor. Definitely should have a 'DO NOT OPERATE HEAVY MACHINERY' disclaimer like alcohol. Typing still sloppy, and I still feel 'odd' and off-balance. I'm fiending for food, so I'm going to drink more water. I'm on a 24-hour fast that ends at 21:00. Vision blurry, still some slight depth distortions and excellent mental focus.
>17:23 (T+04:39)
Other occupants home, effects minimal. I feel agitated and impatient. Still giving zero fucks. Plan to take 200mg caffeine in 30 minutes to induce defecation and kick off my evening. Working out until then.
